headline: Brazil Central Bank Holds Interest Rates at 13.75%
summary: The Central Bank of Brazil maintained its benchmark interest rate at 13.75%. The decision comes as the country monitors factory output and PMI data.
why: The Selic rate is the primary tool used by the Central Bank of Brazil to manage inflation and stabilize the national currency, directly impacting borrowing costs for Brazilian companies and consumers.

impacts.name: Brazil Selic Rate
impacts.why: The central bank held the rate steady at 13.75%.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Maintaining high interest rates influences capital flows into the Brazilian real and affects the valuation of debt-heavy companies like Petrobras.
